notes.title: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS v1.0 - 8 players in the lobby!
notes.content:
[h2]HELLO EVERYONE![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/c58d5d585a9c4d344c144387a1096dc792f04425.gif[/img]

[h2]We are pleased to announce that we are leaving early access. We settled on version 0.6 and completed all the main tasks for developing the game.
But this does not mean that we will stop developing and releasing updates![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/bb8159e0ab098a158c5e88ed0635f78f80cba3c2.png[/img]

[h2]It all depends on you, write reviews, put tags so that as many people as possible can see our game!
The larger the community and feedback, the more actively we will work on the next updates.[/h2]

store.steampowered.com/app/2515210/

[h3]RELEASE v1.0[/h3]

[list]
[*] 8 players in the lobby!
[*] All character models have been completely redesigned.
[*] The sound has been improved - it should now be more spacious.
[*] Fix voice chat.
[*] Improved translation into all languages.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Horror Game | Corridor Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

We would like to introduce you to our game, this is our first horror game and we are looking for people to help us create the perfect indie horror game.

We are recruiting beta testers. All you have to do is play the game and give your opinion. What is missing in the game and what impressed you the most or whether you got any bugs.
This is a very important stage for us in development, and we hope that the community will help us.

Anyone who wants to take part in the beta test, simply submit a beta test request on the store page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461540
[b]
(don't forget to subscribe to the game)[/b]

Send your feedback here https://steamcommunity.com/app/1461540/discussions/0/3002173313627411313/

Or to this mail: rosaspecialstuidio@gmail.com
